policy.contact_desc: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at:
policy.address: Address: NutriNova LLC, 2105 Vista Oeste NW, Albuquerque, NM 87120

banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.description: We use cookies to enhance your experience on FinanzerPro. Some cookies are essential for the website to function, while others help us improve our service and understand how you use our site.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: Required for the website to function properly. Cannot be disabled.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: Remember your preferences and provide enhanced features.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Help us understand how you use our website to improve performance.

legal_basis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legal_basis.description: Under GDPR, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:
legal_basis.contract_desc: Processing necessary to provide our financial management services and perform our contract with you
legal_basis.legitimate_desc: Processing for fraud prevention, service improvement, and business operations
legal_basis.consent_desc: Processing for marketing communications and optional features (you may withdraw consent at any time)
legal_basis.legal_desc: Processing required to comply with legal and regulatory requirements

data_subject_rights.title: Your Data Subject Rights
data_subject_rights.description: As an EU resident, you have the following rights under GDPR:

access.title: Right of Access
access.description: Request a copy of your personal data and information about how we process it

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.description: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data

erasure.title: Right to Erasure
erasure.description: Request deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances

restriction.title: Right to Restriction
restriction.description: Request limitation of processing in specific situations

portability.title: Right to Data Portability
portability.description: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format

objection.title: Right to Object
objection.description: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing

international_transfers.title: International Data Transfers
international_transfers.description: Some of our service providers are located outside the EU. We ensure adequate protection through:

transfers.us_desc: OpenAI (AI processing), Stripe (payments), Clerk (authentication) with adequate safeguards
transfers.safeguards_desc: Standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions, and certification schemes
transfers.adequacy_desc: Transfers to countries with adequate data protection as recognized by the EU Commission

breach_notification.title: Data Breach Notification
breach_notification.description: In the event of a data breach affecting your personal data, we will:
breach_notification.procedure: Notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours and inform affected individuals without undue delay if the breach poses a high risk to your rights and freedoms.

supervisory_authority.title: Supervisory Authority
supervisory_authority.description: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority:
supervisory_authority.contact: Contact your national Data Protection Authority
supervisory_authority.details: Visit the European Data Protection Board website for contact information of all EU data protection authorities

dpo.title: Data Protection Officer
dpo.description: We have appointed a Data Protection Officer to monitor our GDPR compliance:
dpo.responsibilities_desc: Monitoring compliance, conducting privacy impact assessments, and serving as contact point for data subjects and authorities

eu_representative.title: EU Representative
eu_representative.description: For EU residents, our designated EU representative handles GDPR matters:
eu_representative.notice: Notice: EU representative appointment is currently in progress. For GDPR inquiries, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@finanzerpro.com or use our general privacy contact: privacy@finanzerpro.com

exercise_rights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
exercise_rights.description: To exercise any of your data subject rights, please contact us:
exercise_rights.response_desc: We will respond to your request within 30 days (extendable by 60 days for complex requests)

consumer_rights.title: Your Consumer Rights
consumer_rights.description: As a California resident, you have the following rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):

know.title: Right to Know
know.description: Request information about the personal information we collect, use, disclose, and sell

delete.title: Right to Delete
delete.description: Request deletion of personal information we have collected from you

opt_out.title: Right to Opt-Out
opt_out.description: Opt-out of the sale of your personal information (Note: We do not sell personal information)

non_discrimination.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
non_discrimination.description: Receive equal service and pricing even if you exercise your privacy rights

categories_collected.title: Categories of Personal Information Collected
categories_collected.description: We collect the following categories of personal information:

categories.identifiers_desc: Name, email address, phone number, and unique identifiers
categories.commercial_desc: Financial transaction records, spending patterns, and account information
categories.internet_desc: Usage patterns, preferences, and interaction with our service
categories.geolocation_desc: General location information for compliance and service delivery
categories.inferences_desc: AI-generated insights about spending habits and financial preferences

sale_sharing.title: Sale and Sharing of Personal Information
sale_sharing.no_sale: WE DO NOT SELL YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION
sale_sharing.description: FinanzerPro does not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for their marketing purposes.

service_providers.title: Service Providers and Business Partners
service_providers.description: We share personal information with the following service providers for business purposes:

providers.clerk_desc: User authentication and account management services
providers.stripe_desc: Secure payment processing and subscription management
providers.openai_desc: AI-powered financial insights and categorization (anonymized data)
providers.bunny_desc: Secure cloud storage for receipts and export files

exercise_rights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
exercise_rights.description: To exercise your CCPA rights, contact us using the information below:
exercise_rights.response_desc: We will respond to verifiable requests within 45 days (extendable by 45 days)

verification.title: Verification Process
verification.description: To protect your privacy, we verify your identity before processing requests:
verification.procedure: We may request additional information to verify your identity, such as account details or recent transaction information.

bsa.title: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) Compliance
bsa.description: FinanzerPro complies with the Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations:
bsa.aml_procedures: Implementation of comprehensive AML procedures and customer due diligence
bsa.transaction_monitoring: Automated transaction monitoring for suspicious activity patterns
bsa.suspicious_activity: Mandatory reporting of suspicious activity to FinCEN when required
bsa.record_keeping: Maintenance of detailed transaction records as required by federal law

pci_dss.title: PCI DSS Compliance
pci_dss.description: We adhere to Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards through our payment processor Stripe:

data_encryption.title: Data Encryption
data_encryption.description: All payment data is encrypted using industry-standard AES-256 encryption

secure_networks.title: Secure Networks
secure_networks.description: Firewalls and secure network architecture protect cardholder data

access_control.title: Access Control
access_control.description: Strict access controls limit payment data access to authorized personnel only

monitoring.title: Network Monitoring
monitoring.description: Continuous monitoring and regular security testing ensure data protection

data_security.title: Financial Data Security Standards
data_security.description: We implement multiple layers of security to protect your financial information:
data_security.encryption_desc: All data transmission is secured using HTTPS/TLS encryption
data_security.tokenization_desc: User data is isolated and protected with secure authentication
data_security.transmission_desc: All data transfers use TLS 1.3 and HTTPS protocols exclusively
data_security.audits_desc: Independent third-party security audits ensure ongoing compliance

regulatory_disclosures.title: Regulatory Disclosures
regulatory_disclosures.not_advisor: NOT A FINANCIAL ADVISOR: FinanzerPro is not a registered investment advisor or financial planner.
regulatory_disclosures.educational_purposes: Our AI-powered insights and recommendations are for educational and informational purposes only.
regulatory_disclosures.consult_professional: Always consult with qualified financial professionals before making investment or financial decisions.

regulatory_oversight.title: Regulatory Oversight
regulatory_oversight.description: FinanzerPro operates under the oversight of multiple financial regulatory bodies:
regulatory_oversight.finra_desc: Compliance with Financial Industry Regulatory Authority guidelines for technology providers
regulatory_oversight.sec_desc: Adherence to Securities and Exchange Commission regulations regarding financial technology
regulatory_oversight.cfpb_desc: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau compliance for consumer financial services

classification.title: AI System Classification
classification.description: Under the EU AI Act, our AI systems are classified as:
classification.limited_desc: Our financial categorization and insights AI requires transparency disclosures
classification.transparency_desc: Users are informed when interacting with AI systems and their capabilities

transparency.title: AI Transparency Requirements
transparency.description: We provide full transparency about our AI systems:
transparency.clear_disclosure: Clear disclosure when users interact with AI-powered features
transparency.model_information: Information about AI model capabilities and limitations
transparency.data_usage: Explanation of how user data is processed by AI systems
transparency.decision_logic: Overview of AI decision-making processes and logic

bias_fairness.title: AI Bias and Fairness
bias_fairness.description: We implement measures to ensure fair and unbiased AI operation:
bias_fairness.measures: Regular bias testing, diverse training data, and algorithmic fairness assessments ensure equitable AI performance across all user demographics.

scc.title: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
scc.description: We use EU-approved Standard Contractual Clauses for all international data transfers:
scc.stripe_scc: Stripe (Payment Processing): EU-US data transfers covered by SCCs and adequacy decisions
scc.clerk_scc: Clerk (Authentication): SCCs in place for EU-US user authentication data transfers
scc.openai_scc: OpenAI (AI Services): Data processing agreements with SCCs for AI analysis
scc.bunny_scc: Bunny.net (File Storage): European data centers with SCCs for global redundancy

adequacy.title: Adequacy Decisions
adequacy.description: We rely on European Commission adequacy decisions where available:
adequacy.us_framework: US-EU Data Privacy Framework provides adequate protection for transatlantic data flows where applicable.

safeguards.title: Additional Safeguards
safeguards.description: Beyond SCCs, we implement additional protective measures:
safeguards.technical: Technical safeguards: Encryption, pseudonymization, and access controls
safeguards.organizational: Organizational measures: Staff training, data minimization policies
safeguards.contractual: Contractual protections: Data processing agreements with all third parties
safeguards.monitoring: Ongoing monitoring: Regular compliance assessments and audit procedures

gdpr.title: European Privacy Rights
gdpr.notice: As an EU resident, you have enhanced privacy rights under GDPR. See our Privacy Policy for details about your rights to access, rectify, and delete your data.

ccpa.title: California Privacy Rights
ccpa.notice: California residents have specific privacy rights under CCPA. You can request information about data collection and opt-out of data sales.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.description: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create or modify your account, add financial transactions, set budgets, or contact us for support.

usage_data.title: Usage Data:
usage_data.description: How you interact with our service, features used

device_info.title: Device Information:
device_info.description: Browser type, IP address, operating system

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.description: We use the information we collect to:
section2.services: Provide, maintain, and improve our financial management services
section2.transactions: Process transactions and send related information
section2.ai_insights: Provide AI-powered insights and recommendations (Premium users)
section2.notifications: Send technical notices, updates, security alerts, and support messages
section2.support: Respond to your comments and questions
section2.analytics: Analyze usage patterns to improve our service

section8.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking
section8.description: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to provide and improve our service. See our Cookie Policy for detailed information.

section9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
section9.description: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

section3.title: 3. AI-Powered Features and Data Processing
section3.description: FinanzerPro uses artificial intelligence to provide personalized financial insights and recommendations. Here's how we handle your data for AI processing:

ai_provider.title: AI Service Provider:
ai_provider.description: We use OpenAI's GPT models to analyze spending patterns and generate insights

data_anonymization.title: Data Anonymization:
data_anonymization.description: All transaction data is anonymized and stripped of personally identifiable information before AI processing

processing_purpose.title: Processing Purpose:
processing_purpose.description: AI analysis is used exclusively for generating financial recommendations, spending insights, and personalized tips

data_retention.title: Data Retention:
data_retention.description: Anonymized data sent to OpenAI is not stored by the AI service beyond processing requirements

user_control.title: User Control:
user_control.description: You can disable AI features in your account settings to opt-out of this processing

no_personal_data.title: No Personal Data:
no_personal_data.description: Your name, email, account details, or any identifying information is never shared with AI services

important.title: Important:
important.description: AI processing only occurs for Standard and Premium subscribers who have AI features enabled. Free plan users do not have their data processed by AI services.

section4.title: 4. Information Sharing
section4.description: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties except:

service_providers.title: Service Providers:
service_providers.description: Third-party companies that help us operate our service

payment_processing.title: Payment Processing:
payment_processing.description: Stripe for subscription payments (no financial transaction data shared)

ai_processing.title: AI Processing:
ai_processing.description: OpenAI for anonymized financial insights (as detailed in section 3 above)

legal_requirements.title: Legal Requirements:
legal_requirements.description: When required by law or to protect rights and safety

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.description: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information:
section5.ssl_encryption: All data transmission is encrypted using SSL/TLS
section5.password_hashing: Passwords are hashed using industry-standard encryption
section5.limited_access: Limited access to personal data on a need-to-know basis
section5.secure_backup: Secure cloud backup storage with encryption

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.description: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You may delete your account and data at any time through your account settings.

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.access_rights: Access, update, or delete your personal information
section7.export_rights: Export your data in a portable format
section7.information_rights: Request information about how your data is used

section10.title: 10. Contact Us
section10.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
section10.address: Address: NutriNova LLC, 2105 Vista Oeste NW, Albuquerque, NM 87120
